craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. Settling without self-loss: reaching-oneness-yet-keeping-shape — the whole proof in one line; shape end-weight. Rejected: (a) resolving the paradox → killed: kept-shape IS the doctrine. (b) qualifier→attribute → killed: viśeṣaṇa load term. Read aloud: GEN-i-tive-SPOK-en, re-LA-tion SETT-les IN the QUAL-i-fi-er — … YET-keep-ing ITS-own-SHAPE.

lines: Genitive-spoken, relation settles in the qualifier —
reaching oneness with the qualified, yet keeping its own shape.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṣṭhyādivācyaḥ saṃbandho viniviṣṭo viśeṣaṇe viśeṣyaikatvamāpanne svaṃ ca rūpamanujjhati

reads_against.argmap: Where does genitive-relation settle? → Genitive-relation settles in the qualifier, reaches oneness, keeps own form.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
